description: Main source file for the Flutter-based Audiobook Frontend application. Contains app initialization, main widget, data models, state management with Provider, UI screens including list and detail views, and audio playback controls.

classes.name: AudioBook
classes.description: Data model representing an audiobook with metadata such as title, author, cover and audio URLs, description, duration, and release date.

classes.name: BookProvider
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier to manage list of books, search filtering, current selection, and playback state, with persistence via SharedPreferences.

classes.name: BookListScreen
classes.description: Main screen displaying search bar, grid of book cards, and bottom audio player bar.

classes.name: BookDetailScreen
classes.description: Screen displaying detailed info about a selected book, including cover, title, author, description, and audio controls.

classes.name: AudioPlayerBar
classes.description: Widget providing playback controls and current book info, managing its own audio player instance.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point initializing and running the Flutter app with the root widget.

methods.name: _formatDuration
methods.description: Utility function to convert seconds into a formatted string HH:MM:SS or MM:SS.
